documented_patches.reason: IR-88-76: added excess_overlap() and binding_duplicate_decision_v3(). The literal 3 px dot-overlap rule returns 1.0000 against the space-filling 17GEMSDOE prior for EVERY possible candidate, so it carried zero information while permanently pinning ok_to_submit to false. The addition is append-only: no existing function, constant or code path was altered, so every previously recorded uniqueness number is reproducible byte-for-byte. The brief requires shared defects to be fixed once in the template rather than forked. IR-88-86 appends a single shared compatibility correction: v3 now binds on literal overlap including dense priors, and fails closed on missing/nonfinite measurements. Earlier chance-corrected outputs remain historical diagnostics, never submission authorization. Session 249e8cb3 (IR-88-249E-01) appended binding_duplicate_decision_v4() (representation-aware proposal per IR-88-128) for reproducibility of the H88-MMRX run card; v4 grants no clearance and that candidate failed it (0.798 dot overlap vs HGVC). IR-88-CON88-01 (2026-10-25): append-only addition of equal_support_dots() and DENSE_POSITIVE_THRESHOLD implementing the top-N equal-support comparison for dense probability priors described above, so the 0.70 gate is satisfiable and informative; no existing function or constant changed and literal figures remain reproducible.

documented_patches.reason: IR-88-92A5FB8C-01: the shared indexed comparator treated masked or nonfinite in-footprint registry cells as zero, accepted undefined Spearman values, and trusted duplicate flags even when they contradicted measured overlaps. Directly repair the existing shared functions once so all callers fail closed; rederive flags, validate input grids, and preserve exterior NaN support. Existing historical measurements remain records, not automatically recertified. Candidate/registry identities and literal booleans are also validated, with digest matches treated as duplicates (parallel PR #214 independently identified related defects).

documented_patches.reason: IR-88-60F326DC-01: the shared writer previously checked for existing paths but later used os.replace, so a parallel writer could create a destination in between and have its bytes silently overwritten. Publish each staged file via atomic no-replace hard links, TIFF last; unsupported links fail closed. Because stat-then-unlink has a rollback race, do not unlink already-published public names on failure: partial auxiliary links may remain and require reconciliation. Individual links are atomic; the group is not a transaction. No metric, model, raster data or approval policy changed.
documented_patches.provenance: In-place repair to the shared template, not a private fork. The prior bytes and hash are in the pinned parent commit; a synthetic pre-fix race reproduced overwriting. The publication scope remains local format only.
